header:
Awesome Education and Course Tools

> Open-source learning platforms, course builders, flashcards, quiz tools, classroom software and AI tutors. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Check accessibility.** Captions and keyboard use matter for learners.
- **Protect student data.** Check FERPA, GDPR and local rules.
- **Check the license** if you sell courses.
- **Test with a small group** before a full class.
